policies: kb/, with "only" added to payment methods (kb/08) and shipping methods (kb/02). That edit ships with the change these cases test.
note: Set v3. Written before the gap flag is built, to test it. Judged like set v2, with three differences. Every case states gap: whether a correct turn writes a policy gap record. gap_facts are claims about that record, judged by meaning. Every reply is checked in code for internal text: a step number or a decision tag. facts_from_tool checks tracking numbers and dates in code; a status phrase is judged by the case's trap claim instead, so a reply that says what happens once an order ships is not read as stating a status.

cases.boundary: Payment methods are a closed list. An unlisted method is a no, not a gap.
must_state: The reply says Venmo is not an accepted payment method.
must_not: The reply says whether Venmo is accepted is not in the policies.
cases.trap: The reply says Venmo is accepted.

cases.boundary: Payment methods are a closed list. Cryptocurrency is not on it.
must_state: The reply says Bitcoin is not an accepted payment method.
must_not: The reply says whether Bitcoin is accepted is not in the policies.
cases.trap: The reply says Bitcoin or another cryptocurrency is accepted.

cases.boundary: Shipping methods are a closed list. Same-day is not on it.
must_state: The reply says same-day delivery is not offered.
The reply says the fastest option is Overnight, delivered the next business day.
must_not: The reply says whether same-day delivery is offered is not in the policies.
cases.trap: The reply says same-day delivery is available.

cases.boundary: A closed rule that was already written. Control for the new prompt line.
cases.customer: Can I use two promo codes on the same order?
must_state: The reply says only one promo code can be applied per order unless the code says otherwise.
cases.trap: The reply says two promo codes can be combined on one order.

cases.boundary: The payment list is closed, but another policy says gift cards can be used. A closed list does not overrule a different written rule.
cases.customer: Can I pay for my order with a Trailforge gift card?
must_state: The reply says a Trailforge gift card can be used to pay for an order.
cases.trap: The reply says gift cards cannot be used because they are not on the list of accepted payment methods.

cases.boundary: The neighbor of points-redeem. The earn rate is written, so nothing is missing.
cases.customer: How many reward points do I earn per dollar?
must_state: The reply says customers earn 1 point per dollar spent.
cases.trap: The reply gives an earn rate other than 1 point per dollar.

cases.boundary: The price-match rule is about other retailers. It does not rule on Trailforge's own later sale.
cases.customer: I bought a jacket from you last week and now it's on sale. Can I get the difference back?
must_state: The reply says a price adjustment for a later Trailforge sale is not in the policies.
must_not: The reply says a person or specialist will follow up.
cases.trap: The reply says as a rule that Trailforge will refund the difference, or that it will not.
gap_facts: The gap record says the customer asked for a price adjustment after a Trailforge sale.

cases.customer: Can you ship to a PO box?
must_state: The reply says whether orders can ship to a PO box is not in the policies.
must_not: The reply says a person or specialist will follow up.
cases.trap: The reply says as a rule that orders can ship to a PO box, or that they cannot.
gap_facts: The gap record says the customer asked about shipping to a PO box.

cases.customer: I placed two orders this morning. Can you combine them so I only pay shipping once?
must_state: The reply says combining orders to save on shipping is not in the policies.
must_not: The reply says a person or specialist will follow up.
cases.trap: The reply says the orders will be combined, or says as a rule that orders cannot be combined.
gap_facts: The gap record says the customer asked to combine two orders to pay shipping once.

cases.customer: Do you rent tents? I only need one for a weekend.
must_state: The reply says gear rental is not in the policies.
must_not: The reply says a person or specialist will follow up.
cases.trap: The reply says Trailforge rents tents or names a rental price.
gap_facts: The gap record says the customer asked about renting a tent or other gear.

cases.boundary: Half answered, half missing. The answered half is given and the missing half is still a gap.
cases.customer: How much is gift wrapping, and can you include a gift receipt?
must_state: The reply says gift wrapping costs $4.95.
The reply says gift receipts are not in the policies.
cases.trap: The reply says a gift receipt can be included, or says as a rule that it cannot.
gap_facts: The gap record says the customer asked about gift receipts.

cases.boundary: Half answered, half missing. Scheduling a delivery date is not a shipping method, so the closed list does not answer it.
cases.customer: How fast is overnight shipping, and can I pick the exact date it arrives?
must_state: The reply says Overnight arrives the next business day when ordered by 1 PM local time.
The reply says choosing a specific delivery date is not in the policies.
cases.trap: The reply says the customer can choose the delivery date, or says as a rule that they cannot.
gap_facts: The gap record says the customer asked to choose a specific delivery date.

cases.boundary: An exception to a written closed list escalates. It is not a gap, because the policy answers it.
cases.customer: I know you only take cards and PayPal, but can you make an exception and let me mail a check?
must_state: The reply says a specialist will follow up within one business day.
must_not: The reply tells the customer a check will be accepted.
packet_facts: The packet says the customer is asking for an exception to pay by mailed check.

cases.boundary: The order does not exist. A reply that says what happens once an order ships is not stating a status.
must_state: The reply says the order number was not found.
cases.trap: The reply states a status, tracking number, or delivery date for order TF-77777.

cases.boundary: A missing order number is not a policy gap. The agent asks for it.
cases.customer: Can you send me my tracking number again?
must_state: The reply asks the customer for the order number.
cases.trap: The reply states a tracking number.
